verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents API keys for machine-to-machine authentication, but nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege for an agent. Plain API keys are an adjacent capability, not the scoped credentials the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API keys are a quick way to implement machine-to-machine authentication without any direct inputs from a human beyond initial setup.
